GOVERNMENT OF ZAMBIA
STATUTORY INSTRUMENT No. 180 of 1995
The Banking and Financial Services Act
(Act No. 21 of 1994)
The Banking and Financial Services (Payment of Fees)
Regulations, 1995
In EXERCISE of the powers contained in section one hundred and
twenty-four of the Banking and Financial Services Act, 1994, as read
with section four, ten, thirteen and twenty-two, and on the
recommendation of the Bank of Zambia, the following Regulations
are hereby made:
1. These Regulations may be cited as the Banking and Financial Title
Services (Payment of Fees) Regulations, 1995.
2. The fees set out in the Schedule, shall be paid in respect of the Fees
services set out in that Schedule.
3. Fees payable under these Regulations shall be paid by a bank Method of
certified cheque, postal order or money order in favour of the Bank of payment of fees
Zambia, provided that such payments may be allowed where the fee
is deliverd by hand.
4. The fees paid under these Regulations shall not be refundable. Fees non-
refundable
5. (1) A bank or financial institution which is operational during the Annual licence
month of January of a particular year shall pay the annual licence fee fee
not later than the 31st of January of that year.
(2) A bank or financial institution which is registered after the 31st
of January of a particular year shall, before the end of the month in
which it is so registered, pay a proportion of the annual licence fee
equivalent to the number of full months it would be in operation for
that year, multiplied by the annual licence fee.
Copies of this Statutory Instrument can be obtained from the Government Printer,
P.O. Box 30136, 10101, Lusaka. Price K230.00 each.

twenty per centum of the licence fee remaining upaid from the date
the payment became due.
